ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the image, which labeled leaf is lobed?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows five labeled leaf drawings arranged left to right as D, C, B, E, and A. D has a smooth entire edge, C has sharp serrated teeth, B has rounded toothed edges, E has broad rounded projections with deep indentations along the sides, and A is cut more deeply into narrow segments. Reasoning: A lobed leaf has larger projecting sections separated by noticeable cuts, but the cuts do not divide the leaf all the way to the midrib. The leaf labeled E best matches this lobed shape.
